text:
Ana: thinking about a quick UX for per-route analytics — small ask: a "quick capture" that saves the current filter + time window as a temporary snapshot you can pin or compare across models. low effort but big payoff :raised_hands:
Sam: can you sketch how it differs from saved queries?
Ana: yeah — saved queries are permanent and team-shared. quick captures are ephemeral by default (ttl 24h) but can be promoted to saved. meant for ad-hoc debugging during rollouts.
Jordan: how would scoping work? org vs route vs model? we need to avoid duplication and surprise defaults.
Miho: suggestion: default scope = current route context. show a small badge: `scope: route`. user can change to model or org in a dropdown. promoting a capture prompts for scope and ownership.
Lucy: UI note — keep capture compact: timestamp, owner, applied filters inline. allow 1-click compare where you select 2 captures and we render delta charts. :eyes:
Sam: delta charts are great but need clarity on which metrics to diff (p50 latency, p95, cost/tk, quality score). default to p95 + tokens + errors.
Jordan: backend implications: comparing captures needs consistent sampling window & same model version. we should bake in model-version tag at capture time, fallback to nearest compatible. and add metadata: `model_id`, `model_version`, `route_id`, `tz`.
Ana: agreed. also want quick export of the filters as a shareable link that rehydrates the view (eg for support handoff).
Miho: rehydration should include a safety param: `is_capture=true` so shared links don't accidentally create permanent saved queries. example payload:
```
{
  "filters": [{"field":"route","op":"=","value":"/chat/summary"}],
  "window":"15m",
  "model":"redwood-1.2",
  "is_capture": true
}
```
Jordan: technical quirk — if route is updated during capture window (rollout flip), we must record routing policy used. otherwise comparisons are meaningless. add `routing_policy_snapshot` to metadata.
Lucy: UX for promotion flow: small promo CTA on capture card: "Save as query" -> modal to pick folder & visibility (personal/team/org). keep default to personal.
Sam: quotas question — do promoted captures count against saved query limits or some other quota? Product needs to decide.
Ana: my take: promotion counts as saved queries. ephemeral captures do not. we should show a subtle badge on capture: "promotes to saved (counts vs quota)" when hovering.
Jordan: ops note — we'll need an index for capture lookups by route+time. ephemeral TTL helps prune. storage format should be lightweight json blobs with the metadata mentioned.
opsbot: Deploybot: new UI flag `quick_captures` rolled out to prod canary (10%) at 2025-11-02T18:20Z :rocket:
Miho: one more thought — allow keyboard shortcut `C` while on route page to create capture. tiny DX win.
Lucy: agree. will add to mock. also add small visual diff with color encoding (green/red) for metric deltas so it's scan-friendly.
Sam: ok next steps: Jordan + infra to confirm metadata schema and storage approach. Miho + Lucy to produce a 1-slide mock and microcopy. Ana to draft a short product note for eng and support about scope/quotas. I'll collect and sync next Tue. :thumbsup:
